Title: Elevating Maternal Health through Strategic Communications
NewsSummary: Rosemary Wangai's dedication to improving maternal health drives her academic pursuits
NewsContent:
Rosemary Wanjiru Wangai, a seasoned communications professional, is taking her career to new heights by pursuing a Master's in Strategic Communications at Aga Khan University's Graduate School for Media and Communications (GSMC). With over six years of experience in the field, Rosemary has honed her skills in crafting compelling narratives and developing effective communication strategies.

Her decision to pursue a master's degree is driven by a desire to stay ahead of the curve in a rapidly evolving industry. "The field of communications is constantly evolving," she says, "and a master's degree will give me the opportunity to deepen my knowledge and stay ahead of the curve in a dynamic corporate environment."

At Jacaranda Health, Rosemary has been instrumental in developing marketing campaigns, engaging with stakeholders, and promoting the organization's mission to improve maternal and child health. Her work has involved creating tailored communication strategies that resonate with diverse audiences and drive positive change.

Rosemary's passion for her work is evident in her commitment to using communication to address social  issues. "Effective communication is not just about sharing information; it's about inspiring action," she explains. "As a communications professional, my job is to amplify our message, highlight the stories of the people we serve, and build trust with our stakeholders."

Through her studies at AKU, Rosemary is gaining a deeper understanding of strategic communication theories and practices. She is particularly interested in exploring how digital technologies can be used to reach and engage audiences more effectively.

As Rosemary continues her journey, she is confident that her master's degree will equip her with the tools she needs to succeed in the ever-evolving world of communications. "By enhancing my skills and gaining new insights, I hope to contribute to making Jacaranda Health an even more effective force for good," she concludes.
